name: Esther
overview: The book of Esther reveals God's providential care through Esther, also called Hadassah, a niece of Mordecai who was chosen as queen because she found favor with the king (Esther 2:7, 2:15-17). When Mordecai uncovered a plot against the king's life, Esther courageously informed the king, demonstrating her faithfulness and influence (Esther 2:22). Facing a decree to destroy the Jewish people, Esther called for a fast and boldly interceded before the king, trusting God's sovereign purpose in her rise to the throne for such a time as this (Esther 4:14, 4:16).
